hold_text: Tier-3 prop config: config/prop_rulesets/breakout_routing.yaml gains ADAUSDT->ADAUSD and XRPUSDT->XRPUSD, contract_value_usd_per_point 1.0. Re-authored by lane PROP-MAP after manager-scope-guard correctly refused the manager session (session_01KAQRJxRbRwpYTkPgBjNVyQ) from committing this itself, because a manager must not author config or tests. The underlying change is unchanged from the manager's draft (PR #13513, closed, not merged; commit 43b0f40b) -- only config/prop_rulesets/breakout_routing.yaml, tests/test_prop_symbol_map.py, and the two pipeline records (closing PI-20260927-ODDTM5QY-0002, filing PI-20260928-PGBJNVYQ-0001) were cherry-picked; that commit's own .github/pr-automerge-requests and .github/pr-landing files were dropped in favour of this lane's own landing hold. Operator approval is recorded in PR #13513's body and the register merged in PR #13501: chat with the manager, 2026-09-28, choosing "Add both + min-size note", based on the operator's own DXtrade Instrument Details screenshots for breakout_1 (Lot Size 1, Size Steps 1, Margin 20% both symbols; ADA 10-400000 lots precision 0.0001, XRP 10-110000 lots precision 0.001), consistent with the passive network read of ETH/SOL in issue #13503 (lotSize 1, multiplier 1 = the confirmed 1.0). The screenshots themselves were sent in chat and cannot be committed as evidence. This is a mapping-only change: no strategy is routed to breakout_1 by this diff, and the venue's unenforced 10-lot minimum is tracked separately (PI-20260928-PGBJNVYQ-0001) and must land before either leg is routed. Holding for the manager to merge after CI so a human record exists for the config mutation itself, independent of the chat approval already given.
why: Lands the config + test + pipeline-record slice of PR #13513 under this lane's own authorship, since the manager cannot author config/tests directly (manager-scope-guard). config/prop_rulesets/breakout_routing.yaml is a prop order-routing config (Tier-3 per docs/CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL.md Permission Tiers: strategy logic + params). tests/test_prop_symbol_map.py moves the unmapped-passthrough example from XRPUSDT (now mapped) to DOGEUSDT and adds a bidirectional ADA/XRP mapping test; the two new docs/claude/work/pipeline/20260928T0710*.json records close PI-20260927-ODDTM5QY-0002 (the original unconfirmed-mapping question) and file PI-20260928-PGBJNVYQ-0001 (the unenforced venue lot-minimum follow-up). 212 prop tests pass locally (python3 -m pytest -q against every test file matching breakout_routing|breakout_executor|breakout_ticket).
